  1. Root Zone Management

Top-Level Domains

The Top-Level Domain Registry represents the delegation details of top-level domains in the Domain Name System (DNS). IANA manages the DNS root zone with these delegations in accordance with our policies and procedures.

This data is available for download in multiple formats.
